entries.mutation: Validate the synthetic trajectory split with all train, validation, and test roles populated.
entries.expected: Accept the split and preserve complete trajectory-level grouping.

entries.mutation: Assign the same trajectory to the split manifest twice.
Place a diagnostic family in training and held-out test.
Declare a family held out without assigning it to test.
entries.expected: Reject mismatch between declared held-out families and actual test-family assignments.

entries.mutation: Build a run manifest with all required artifact roles, valid digests, exact split digest, and the complete test trajectories.
entries.expected: Accept only when run identity and artifact catalog agree.

entries.mutation: Change split-manifest bytes but leave the recorded digest untouched.
Add the oracle artifact to candidate-visible artifact IDs.
Pair a baseline run with a Symthaea-assisted run using identical protocol gates and test trajectories.
entries.expected: Accept the B0/B1 pair for a held-out test comparison.

entries.mutation: Change the policy-gate digest between B0 and B1.
entries.expected: Reject the comparison; policy-gate drift confounds the ablation.

entries.mutation: Give the augmented system a different test trajectory set.
entries.expected: Reject the run or pair before reporting comparative scores.

entries.mutation: Check mutation IDs and named test linkage.
entries.expected: All mutation IDs are unique and every row points to a test function.

entries.mutation: Change the base system revision, model configuration, or prompt configuration between B0 and B1 while keeping the same policy-gate hash.
entries.expected: Reject the paired ablation because the advisor is no longer the only intervention being tested.

entries.mutation: Create a candidate-visible observation manifest containing exactly the complete trajectories assigned to the run's split role and bind the exact bytes.
entries.expected: Accept the run only when the visible case set and exact observation-manifest digest both match.

entries.mutation: Give a test-only run the full observation manifest that includes training and validation trajectories.
Reformat or otherwise change the candidate-visible observation bytes while retaining the run's old digest.
entries.expected: Reject with observation_manifest_digest_mismatch even when parsed trajectory IDs remain unchanged.
